ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) and record the driver's invalid no-show cancellation (NS-3).

rejected_claims.reason: Driver claims he 'was parked at the pickup' and waited >3 min; the system GPS (which overrides statements) shows him stationary ≈190–205 m from the pickup pin at 14:07–14:11, outside the 200 m arrival radius, and outside his own 'side road' text at 14:07:50 — so the NS-1(ii) requirement is not met.
